tools.name: errand_list_capabilities
tools.description: Use before a local-human or physical-world task to see what Errand can do for this account: supported on-site task types (check, verify, photograph, queue, pickup), spend caps, allowed area, KRW balance, and pricing. Read-only.

tools.name: errand_check_coverage
tools.description: Check whether a nearby human can be dispatched to a physical location before spending. Returns reachable_workers (switched on, seen within 24h — these get the push) and online_workers (app open this minute). tools.name: errand_quote
tools.description: Get the exact read-only quote for sending a human to a real-world location for a check, verification, photo, queue task, or pickup. tools.name: errand_dispatch
tools.description: Send a nearby real human to a physical location for on-site verification, store/shelf/price checks, photos, queue checks or holding, or a pickup. tools.name: errand_get_status
tools.description: Track a previously dispatched local human task: open · accepted · arrived · submitted · completed · failed · cancelled · expired, plus its event timeline. Use after errand_dispatch while the person is traveling or working on site.

tools.name: errand_get_result
tools.description: Retrieve the verified on-site result from a human task: pass/fail verdict, score and feedback, signed photo URLs, structured answers, and evidence provenance including GPS distance, capture time, and server checks.

tools.name: errand_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a real-world human dispatch while it is still open and refund the escrow in full. Fails once a worker has accepted and may already be traveling.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: errand_get_result · Public sink: errand_dispatch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: errand_get_result · Public sink: errand_dispatch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
